text:
Samir Patel: quick follow-up from the postmortem — noticing the same rollout pattern across two incidents: wide initial percentage + no strict auto-rollback. want to capture action items and owners so this doesn't repeat.
Priya Nair: +1. we should make small, actionable changes first: tighten canary windows and add an explicit abort on qps/error spikes.
Diego Morales: Agreed. I can drive the auto-rollback config work. proposal: default rollout to 5% -> 20% over 30m, with auto-rollback if 5m error_rate > 3% or latency p95 regresses > 50%.
Lina Chen: that sounds reasonable. can we add a per-route blast-radius cap so a single feature-flag can't exceed X concurrent users?
Samir Patel: yes — per-route caps + global "blast_radius_budget" is the plan. Diego, can you propose config keys and a small schema?
Diego Morales: will do. rough sketch:```yaml
rollout:
  initial_pct: 5
  ramp_minutes: 30
  max_pct: 20
auto_rollback:
  error_rate_threshold: 0.03
  window: 5m
blast_radius:
  per_route_max_users: 1000
  global_budget: 5000
```
Priya Nair: nice. also add a safety timeout: if canary hasn't hit success metrics after 45m, pause and open a handoff to oncall.
Lina Chen: I can own the blast radius enforcement middleware and add the metric hooks. target ETA: next Thu (2026-04-02).
Diego Morales: I'll own auto-rollback + rollout schema. ETA: next Tue (2026-03-31). I'll open a PR and link tests.
Samir Patel: I'll update the postmortem action tracker with these owners and timelines. Action item list for clarity: 1) Diego - auto-rollback schema + integration tests (due 2026-03-31) 2) Lina - blast radius middleware + metrics (due 2026-04-02) 3) Priya - runbook update & oncall handoff logic (due 2026-04-03) 4) Samir - update postmortem tracker + follow up sync (due 2026-03-30)
ops-bot: deploy-checklist: runbook link created -> https://redwood.internal/postmortems/rollout-2026-03-25
Priya Nair: also we should add a recurring quarterly audit for feature flags that have >1 incident correlation. can we make that a ticket?
Samir Patel: created ticket #INF-4721 for quarterly flag audit, assigning to product-security for coordination.
Diego Morales: FYI I'll include a small simulation harness in the PR so we can validate rollback triggers against historical traffic.
Lina Chen: if anyone wants to pair on the middleware tests I'm available Thu morning.
Samir Patel: thanks all — I'll run a 15-min sync Fri to walk the plan and unblock anything. :thumbsup:
Priya Nair: ack. feel free to drop agenda in the calendar invite.
Diego Morales: noted. starting branch now.
Lina Chen: thanks — marking action items in the tracker.
Samir Patel: closing loop here for now. we'll use this thread for quick updates.
